summary: Frontend preview loaded without runtime errors. Overview values and all requested page navigation were verified; mobile menu and overflow checks were exercised. Several action flows were reached, while one combined script stopped due to a test-order mistake.

rca of the issue: No product issue reproduced. The test script navigated through health, inspection, prediction, reports, and settings, then incorrectly attempted to locate the health export control without navigating back to Health.
